mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_question WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_question SET title=#{title},stem_html=#{stemHtml},answer_html=#{answerHtml},analysis_html=#{analysisHtml},stem_text=#{stemText},stem_hash=#{stemHash},has_image=#{hasImage},status=#{status},subject=#{subject},content_kind=#{contentKind},layout_mode=#{layoutMode},unit_kind=#{unitKind},pagination_mode=#{paginationMode},layout_note=#{layoutNote},item_count=#{itemCount},question_type=#{questionType},difficulty=#{difficulty},creation_kind=#{creationKind},source_note=#{sourceNote},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT kp_id FROM kb_question_kp WHERE question_id=#{id} ORDER BY kp_id
SELECT question_id,asset_id FROM kb_question_asset WHERE question_id IN #{id} ORDER BY question_id,asset_id
SELECT asset_id FROM kb_question_asset WHERE question_id=#{id} ORDER BY asset_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_material_item WHERE question_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE question_id=#{id})+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE parent_question_id=#{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_product_question WHERE question_id=#{id}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_render_job_item WHERE question_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_verified_exam_source e ON e.source_id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE q.id=#{id} AND q.content_kind='EXERCISE' AND s.source_kind='EXAM' AND e.authenticity_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash)
SELECT d.*,q.title AS parent_title FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=d.parent_question_id WHERE child_question_id=#{id} ORDER BY is_primary DESC,parent_question_id

SELECT d.*,q.title AS parent_title FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=d.parent_question_id WHERE child_question_id IN #{id} ORDER BY child_question_id,is_primary DESC,parent_question_id
SELECT d.*,q.title AS child_title FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=d.child_question_id WHERE parent_question_id=#{id} ORDER BY child_question_id

WITH RECURSIVE region_tree AS (SELECT region_code FROM kb_region WHERE region_code=#{code} OR (#{code} IN ('CN','00000000') AND region_code IN ('CN','00000000')) UNION ALL SELECT r.region_code FROM kb_region r JOIN region_tree t ON r.parent_code=t.region_code) SELECT DISTINCT region_code FROM region_tree
